profile.name: 在线测量显示组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件显示组件，用于在测量过程中实时显示数据。它可从 DataReceiver 接收测量数据，或直接接收打包的数据数组，并在独立绘图进程中显示电压、电流、时间等曲线，以避免界面冻结；同时支持配置坐标轴显示方式和控制数据发送间隔。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software display component for live visualization of measurement data during an experiment. It can receive data from a DataReceiver object or from packed data arrays, and renders voltage, current, time, and related traces in a separate plotting process to avoid UI freezing; it also supports configurable axis layouts and data send intervals.

This is a non-physical software display component for live visualization of measurement data during an experiment. It can receive data from a DataReceiver object or from packed data arrays, and renders voltage, current, time, and related traces in a separate plotting process to avoid UI freezing; it also supports configurable axis layouts and data send intervals.
